decisions.reason: Obvious AI-generated pseudo-drawing; formal drawings should use authentic existing sources with filters and composition.

rules: No generated technical drawings, schematics, cartography or pseudo-lettering.
For formal linework, preserve authentic source geometry; crop, scale, invert, tint and compose deterministically.
Keep original source, attribution, rights statement and output hashes.

candidates.label: Field kit
candidates.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: an actual UI background artwork, very wide horizontal 3:1 banner, 2172 x 724 or similar. NOE post-apocalyptic RPG character sheet. Photorealistic close-up, nearly flat straight-on view of a worn dark charcoal field-equipment bag: tightly woven faded canvas, one broad doubled fabric seam and a short length of utilitarian webbing concentrated in the far right third. Quiet fabric surface across the left two thirds for a white character name. Material should feel like durable late 20th century field gear, heavily handled, subtle dust and softened fibers, pragmatic and understated. Neutral graphite palette #191e23 to #394047, only extremely muted gray olive undertones. Soft flat light, low contrast, visible material but no cinematic highlights. It is a banner texture behind dense software UI, not a product beauty shot. No drawing, no schematic, no numbers or letters, no badges, no logo, no interface, no frame, no loose scattered props, no firearms, no characters. No bright green, brown leather, orange rust, or neon. Opaque image, no transparency.
candidates.treatment: WEBP encoding only; source composition unchanged.

candidates.label: Roadside
candidates.description: Weathered asphalt and faded road edge.
candidates.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: very wide 3:1 raster banner alone for the header background of the NOE post-apocalyptic RPG character sheet. A restrained, photographic straight-down view of old asphalt on a deserted road: fine aggregate, a few believable branching age cracks, soft accumulated dust, a single extremely faded fragment of a white road-edge line near the far right edge. Road texture feels grounded in a real abandoned landscape, late twentieth century American infrastructure, no cinematic fantasy. Left 65 percent calm and dark for white text and controls; right third carries the subtly more recognizable road markings and cracks. Neutral graphite black and slate gray, all low contrast around #191e23 to #46505a. Soft overcast light. No dramatic perspective, no horizon, no cars, no people, no weapon, no symbols, no letters, no numbers, no UI, no vignette frame, no orange, no yellow hazard stripes, no glow. The asphalt must remain subtle enough to sit behind a dense software interface. Opaque image, no transparency.
candidates.treatment: WEBP encoding only; source composition unchanged.

candidates.label: Shelter
candidates.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: a very wide 3:1 horizontal background banner artwork for dense utilitarian NOE post-apocalyptic RPG software. Flat straight-on close view of a dark, old cast-concrete shelter wall. Convincing fine pores, faint formwork impressions, a repaired horizontal seam and a very small area of chipped paint at the far right. Restrained weathering, dry matte surface, quiet broad gray planes. The left 65 percent is especially calm and uninterrupted for white character name and controls, visual identity is concentrated on the right third. Neutral graphite/slate gray, roughly #191e23 to #48515a, low contrast flat ambient lighting. Human-used and pragmatic, late 20th century civil shelter, without theatrical bunker clichés. No drawn lines, no schematic, no text, no stencils, no symbols, no doors or corridors, no perspective vanishing point, no UI controls, no exposed glowing equipment, no hazard stripes, no frame, no skull, no dramatic rust streaks. This is supporting background material behind real UI, not concept-art scenery. Opaque image.
candidates.treatment: WEBP encoding only; source composition unchanged.
